recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: What's your partner's favorite song right now?
Which artist would they see live?
What song do they sing in the shower?
Their go-to song on a road trip?
The first concert they went to?
A song that always makes them cry?
Which song reminds them of you?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Music edition: 8 questions about your partner's taste in songs. Do you know their shower playlist?

Comment your score!
